claims.text: Castrate-resistant CA w bone mets: high-dose IV zoledronic acid (bisphosphonate) or denosumab (RANK ligand inhibitor) to minimize skeletal-related events such as fractures.
claims.quote: Castrate-resistant prostate cancer patients with bone metastases should receive high-dose IV zoledronic acid (bisphosphonate) or denosumab (rank ligand inhibitor) specifically to minimize skeletal-related events, such as fractures.
